name: Granddaddy Purple - Indica Live Resin 1g 510 Vape Device — BREEZE Canna
description:
Discover the royal lineage of Grandaddy Purple with its distinctive grape and berry sweetness complemented by subtle spice notes. 

Featuring myrcene, alpha pinene, and beta caryophyllene terpenes, this classic indica delivers deeply calming body effects and dreamy euphoria perfect for stress relief.
